stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.5.0 adds Dashboard search and filters, a Clear override action, and Prepare now for a single selected APPLY or eligible REVIEW vacancy without repeating a full discovery run. Prepare now re-checks scoring, strong evidence, location and hard experience blockers before opening the form. Company detection is improved using search-card, structured, DOM, metadata and authenticated-page signals. Final employer Submit remains manual.
